entries.title: Independent non-PCNA extraction selection and final 1W60 pre-MD gate
entries.purpose: Freeze extraction policy without PCNA and apply once to frozen 1W60 seed outputs.
entries.hypothesis_tested: A non-PCNA-selected extraction policy yields a seed-stable candidate 1W60 region.
entries.command: python3 scripts/independent_extraction_gate.py select-policy && python3 scripts/independent_extraction_gate.py apply-1w60
entries.actual_outcome: PRE-MD STABILITY PASS; production MD not started.
entries.interpretation: Supports governed MD handoff request only.

entries.title: Post-pass stronger internal robustness audit for 1W60 extraction stability
entries.purpose: Diagnose the prior 0.6792 1W60 Jaccard result and test whether an independently justified extraction refinement can meet the new internal >=0.75 mean-Jaccard release target.
entries.hypothesis_tested: A stronger extraction policy can be justified from non-PCNA validation without using PCNA stability and then optionally applied once to 1W60.
entries.null_hypothesis: No materially better independent extraction policy is justified; the current 0.6792 result remains below the new internal release target.
entries.expected_outcome: UNVERIFIED / INSUFFICIENT PROJECT EVIDENCE before this audit.
entries.actual_outcome: Same physical pocket core with nontrivial boundary/fringe extension disagreement; no materially better extraction policy was independently justified; no second 1W60 run and no MD were started.
entries.interpretation: Strong internal pre-MD release robustness target was not achieved. Retraining is not currently justified by this evidence.
entries.notes: This is a post-pass stricter internal release standard, not a retroactive change to the earlier exploratory PASS and not a universal literature threshold.

entries.title: Final independent benchmark expansion before MD decision
entries.purpose: Search for additional eligible independent extraction-development structures and decide whether a replacement extraction policy is justified.
entries.actual_outcome: No independently justified replacement policy; proceed to control-first MD after Gate-6 approval.
entries.interpretation: Moderate/exploratory computational pass with explicit boundary uncertainty.
